conclusion: Preliminary single-seed (seed 7) result with mse only: OLS (linear) achieved lower mse than the matched training-mean baseline on 10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10 with clean training data. This is a preliminary report, not a general claim.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single-seed, single-metric result; no variance or robustness assessment.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
